statements.t: "Favorable price/cost has more than offset unfavorable volume and transportation costs, contributing to robust profitability in the quarter, which we expect to continue into the second half of the year.
We are experiencing lower inflationary pressure than initially expected on materials, mitigating the need for corresponding pricing actions that had previously been included in our net sales outlook.
The demand environment is softer today than when we initially issued guidance in May, driven by higher interest rates and ongoing geopolitical uncertainty.
These changes are reflected in our updated revenue outlook."

"Because of our focus on new product introductions, material conversion, managing price/cost, executing on productivity and deploying capital in a disciplined manner, the Adjusted EBITDA outlook is largely the same despite the change in net sales guidance.

We remain confident in the long-term fundamentals of ADS as a pure-play water management company, and we believe the investments we are making today position us to deliver as our end markets recover."
Based on results to date, current visibility, backlog of existing orders and business trends, the Company updated its financial targets for fiscal 2027.

There can be no assurance that any additional financing will be available to us on acceptable terms or at all.

We plan to repatriate earnings from Canada and believe that there will be no additional tax costs associated with the repatriation of such earnings other than any potential non-U.S. withholding taxes.
We currently anticipate that we will make capital expenditures of approximately $200 million in fiscal year 2027, including approximately $80 million of open orders as of September 30, 2026.
